#1 position — line layout: head and tail triangles opposed (tail rotated 180° — orientation staged); the cancelling equation itself becomes the polar axis (-1)/(+1) — the scene's own correction carried by its sign; pointer vortex — the round's turning seen.

#2 fork — the mouth · becomes ⑂ and moves to the fork's place (the Eden trade staged as the sign's own transformation); Saturn dims (detention); C24's disc carries an attract field (the mouth that takes every answer); pointer attract/implode — the swallowing.

#3 torus — THE 3D SCENE. z is the torus's through-depth: the torus ring at z 0, the retained opening deep at z −0.38 (the hole you look through, not at), the winding matheme carriers nearest (z +0.3–0.35); (2,−1) becomes [2t,−t] — the displaced lift stated as the path; vortex3d drives the winding; winding LFO on circulation; pointer vortex/vortex; duration 16 — the complete creature held.

#4 variants — ring layout: the comparanda in circulation; the self-rolling wheel ◯↻ turns half a turn (rotation in objectState — continuing formation); pointer vortex gentle.

#5→0 return — the round kept WITH its hole: the intact opening disc holds steady inside the ring (constitutive, not absent); the eightfold carrier bright; ∙ dims to near-still — rest; auto-rest breathes pointer strength. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0's ring wore a costume that hid the opening behind visible completion (the ? at the rim); #5→0 re-forms the same ring with the hole held visible inside it and no filled costume — wholeness keeping its opening; the ? is gone not because it was answered in words but because the structure now carries it (the eightfold −/−→1/0 in the field, C21's efficacy-in-relation, rest without demanded continuation).

Human-amplified staging (binding flags kept): the eightfold recapitulation and the Māyā-not-the-hole distinction yes — carried in the #5→0 body; the paśu correction shared with the Neumann whole; the declared cross-story (torus ↔ uroboros, Māyā-not-the-hole, paśu, self-rolling wheel) in binding relations. Mythemic verbs only: the image embodies the difference between renewal and detention; the matheme grounds the exact neighbour — no collapse of mytheme into topology or scripture into torus.
Automation: auto-wind (the winding), auto-rest (the release's breath). Durations 11–16, transitions 1.1–2.2: the torus held longest.
